description: This file defines an Angular component named 'Row'. It appears to be a UI layout component for rendering a horizontal row with flexible alignment and distribution styles. It extends a dynamic rendering base class and uses Angular features such as decorators, templates, and bindings.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: An Angular component for rendering a flexible horizontal layout row with customizable alignment and distribution properties.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: Input property defining the alignment of items within the row, defaulting to 'stretch'.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Input property defining the distribution of items within the row, defaulting to 'start'.

methods.name: classes
methods.description: A computed property that generates CSS classes based on alignment and distribution properties, merged with theme styles.
